players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K: the US$373 million five-year cloud computing service agreement with a global AI platform will deploy cloud computing solutions across SharonAI's AI infrastructure in Australia; the initial deployment is expected to utilize 2,048 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs, with revenue expected to commence during the first quarter of 2027, and additional deployments may occur over the term in accordance with customer requirements.
quarterly_data.figure: 2,048 B300 GPUs initial deployment; revenue from Q1 2027
